# IERC1155FullSupply
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/extensions/ERC1155FullSupply/IERC1155FullSupply.sol)

**Inherits:**
IERC1155

**Title:**
IERC1155FullSupply

**Author:**
Roberto Cano <robercano>

Extension of `IERC1155` that exposes a per-account aggregate balance across all ids in
addition to the per-id totals provided by OpenZeppelin's `ERC1155Supply`.


## Functions
### balanceOfAll

Returns the sum of `account`'s balances across every token id of this contract.


```solidity
function balanceOfAll(address account) external view returns (uint256);
```
